description: This file defines the Workbook class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically responsible for writing XLS (BIFF) format workbooks. It includes methods for managing fonts, colors, styles, shared strings, and worksheet references, as well as assembling the final binary representation of an Excel workbook. The code handles various BIFF records, palette management, and external references for Excel files.

classes.name: Workbook
classes.description: Handles the construction and writing of an XLS workbook in BIFF format, including management of styles, fonts, colors, shared strings, worksheet references, and drawing objects.

methods.name: writeWorkbook
methods.description: Assembles worksheet streams and writes the complete BIFF workbook data, including global records, sheet records, and external references.

methods.name: calcSheetOffsets
methods.description: Calculates byte offsets for each worksheet's BOF (Beginning of File) record within the workbook stream.

methods.name: writeAllFonts
methods.description: Outputs all font definitions collected for the workbook.

methods.name: writeAllNumberFormats
methods.description: Outputs all custom number format records.

methods.name: writeAllXfs
methods.description: Outputs all XF (cell format) records.

methods.name: writeAllStyles
methods.description: Outputs style records, including font, fill, border styles.

methods.name: writeDefinedNameBiff8
methods.description: Creates a Named Range (DefinedName) record with specified formula data for BIFF8.

methods.name: writeShortNameBiff8
methods.description: Creates a short Named Range record suitable for print titles and print areas.

methods.name: writeCodepage
methods.description: Outputs the CODEPAGE record indicating string encoding.

methods.name: writeWindow1
methods.description: Outputs the WINDOW1 record with window display options.

methods.name: writeBoundSheet
methods.description: Outputs a BOUNDSHEET record for each worksheet with its offset and state.

methods.name: writeSupbookInternal
methods.description: Outputs the internal SUPBOOK record referencing sheets.

methods.name: writeExternalsheetBiff8
methods.description: Outputs RECORDS that reference external sheets for formulas.

methods.name: writeStyle
methods.description: Outputs the STYLE record.

methods.name: writeNumberFormat
methods.description: Outputs a FORMAT record for custom number formats.

methods.name: writeDateMode
methods.description: Outputs the DATEMODE record indicating 1904 or 1900 date system.

methods.name: writeCountry
methods.description: Outputs the COUNTRY record for localization.

methods.name: writeRecalcId
methods.description: Outputs the RECALCID record for recalculation ID.

methods.name: writePalette
methods.description: Outputs the PALETTE record for color palette.

methods.name: writeSharedStringsTable
methods.description: Outputs the SST (Shared String Table) records, potentially split into CONTINUE blocks, for shared strings.

methods.name: writeMsoDrawingGroup
methods.description: Outputs MSODRAWINGGROUP in the presence of drawing objects.

methods.name: getEscher
methods.description: Returns the Escher object managing drawings.

methods.name: setEscher
methods.description: Sets the Escher object for drawings.
